quotes.title: WASP-107
quotes.card: WASP-107 is a K6V-type main sequence star located 210 light-years from Earth in the constellation of Virgo.
quotes.introduction: It has a mass of 0.68 solar masses with a radius of 0.67 solar radii.

notes: WASP-107 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
